security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown examples, code fences, reference URLs, and fixed documentation links. One static network finding remains because the guide recommends cloning unpinned third-party source code, and semantic review found missing guardrails for voice cloning. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the Voicebox repository to a reviewed commit or release, prefer official installers, and require explicit user approval before running setup commands.

remediation.issue: Voice cloning consent and licensing checks are missing
remediation.suggestion: Add clear requirements to verify consent, usage rights, and platform policy compliance before cloning or generating any recognizable voice.

remediation.issue: External API examples lack privacy warnings
remediation.suggestion: State that prompts, scripts, images, and voice text may be sent to third-party services when users run the API examples.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Third-Party Source Build Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The Voicebox section recommends cloning a GitHub repository and running setup commands from source without pinning a commit or requiring explicit approval. This creates supply-chain risk if an agent or user follows the workflow automatically.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The referenced lines show a source-build path using git clone followed by make setup and make dev. The risk is contextual because it depends on execution, but the unpinned remote-code workflow is explicit.

semantic_findings.title: Voice Cloning Guidance Lacks Consent Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The generative tools guide recommends cloning a brand spokesperson voice and using cloned voices across ad variations without stating consent, licensing, or impersonation checks. This could enable misuse of a recognizable voice in advertising.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text specifically recommends voice cloning for brand spokesperson use cases. It may be legitimate with permission, but the absence of consent and licensing safeguards leaves a clear misuse path.

content.value_statement: Scaling ad creative requires many tested variations for each platform. This skill turns product context and performance data into ready-to-review ad copy.
actual_capabilities: Generates headlines, descriptions, and primary text for major ad platforms.
Checks creative against platform character limits before delivery.
Groups copy by audience angle, motivation, and offer type.
Analyzes user-provided performance data to find winning creative patterns.
Produces bulk ad copy formats for large variation sets.
Suggests image, video, and voice generation workflows for ad assets.
limitations: Does not choose budgets, targeting, or full campaign strategy.
Requires accurate product, audience, and offer context for strong outputs.
Does not verify live platform policy changes beyond included references.
External tool examples require user-approved credentials and execution.

use_cases.title: Build Google Search Ad Sets
use_cases.description: Create responsive search ad headlines and descriptions for keywords, offers, and audience intent.

use_cases.title: Refresh Social Ad Copy
use_cases.description: Generate new Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, or X copy angles from product positioning and customer pain points.

use_cases.title: Scale Creative Testing
use_cases.description: Turn performance data into new copy variations that extend winning themes and retire weak angles.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Starter Ads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Google Ads responsive search copy for [product] targeting [audience] and the keyword [keyword]. Include 12 headlines, 4 descriptions, angles, and character counts.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Copy Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this offer for Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok: [offer]. Keep each platform within its copy limits and explain the main angle for each set.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate From Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ad results: [paste performance data]. Identify winning and losing patterns, then create 20 new variations that build on the strongest themes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Creative Test Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a creative testing batch for [product], [audience], and [platforms]. Include 5 angles, copy variations for each angle, and notes on what each test should prove.

output_examples.input: Google Ads copy for a project management tool targeting small agencies.
output_examples.output: A set of search headlines and descriptions grouped by pain relief, speed, collaboration, and proof. Each item includes a character count and trimmed alternatives.

output_examples.input: Meta ad variations for a free trial offer.
output_examples.output: Primary text, headline, and description options across benefit-led, problem-led, social proof, and urgency angles.

output_examples.input: Performance data from existing ads with CTR and conversion rate.
output_examples.output: A short performance summary, winning copy patterns, weak themes to avoid, and new variations for the next test round.

best_practices: Provide product positioning, audience details, offer terms, and platform before asking for copy.
Ask for character counts and trimmed alternatives for every platform-limited asset.
Use performance data to guide iteration instead of changing many variables at once.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic ads without audience, offer, or platform context.
Do not reuse one platform format across every channel without adaptation.
Do not approve voice cloning or generated media without consent and rights checks.

faq.question: Which ad platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X copy formats.

faq.question: Can it create responsive search ads?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create Google Ads RSA headlines and descriptions with character counts.

faq.question: Can it use existing performance data?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste metrics or exports, and it can identify patterns and generate new variations.

faq.question: Does it handle campaign strategy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on creative generation and iteration, not budget allocation or targeting.

faq.question: Can it help with image or video ads?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides prompt and workflow guidance for image, video, and voice ad assets.

faq.question: Does it publish ads automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares creative for review and upload through user-approved tools or workflows.
